summary: Frontend-only check of MUNI-01, 03, 05 and 06 plus the no-coverage warning, using session_token cookies at 1920x1080. Everything requested passes. MUNI-05: the admin sees admin-tab-muni-rates and it opens a rates table with 15 La Habana municipalities. The deliveries employee has no admin-tab-muni-rates in the DOM but sees every other operational tab. MUNI-01: TEST_UI373 Cheap (300) with Vedado shows delivery-quote-result at 3 USDT, delivery-quote-free is absent, redeem-courier-fee-line shows '+3.00 USDT' and redeem-grand-total shows '303.00 USDT'. TEST_UI373 Big (1200) shows delivery-quote-free with no fee line, as expected. MUNI-06: confirm-redeem stays enabled, but clicking it with an empty address, a short address ('Calle') or a short phone ('+53 55') only shows the matching Spanish toast and the dialog stays open. MUNI-03: switching Vedado to Arroyo Naranjo was tracked with a MutationObserver. The sequence was enabled with quote, then disabled while delivery-quote-loading showed, then enabled with the new 5 USDT quote (grand total 305.00). No-coverage: 'Mi municipio no aparece' shows redeem-no-coverage-block, redeem-no-coverage-warning and no-coverage-contact-btn, and confirm-redeem is disabled. Going back to Vedado enables it again. No redemption was submitted.

issues: The Mensajería column shows a paid courier fee as '-$2.2'. It uses a '$' sign even though the fee is in USDT, and the number is not formatted to 2 decimals. Suggest '+2.20 USDT' or '2.20 USDT', to match the '+3.00 USDT' shown in the redeem dialog.
The municipality select still says 'Vedado — 3 USDT' while delivery-quote-free says shipping is free. A small 'gratis' hint in the trigger or option would avoid confusion.

action_items: Optional: format the history courier fee as 'X.XX USDT' instead of '-$X' (MarketplaceView.jsx around line 528).

Expected behaviour, not a bug: in the marketplace dialog, delivery-no-coverage is hidden on purpose by suppressNoCoverageNote (a fix from iter375). The parent's redeem-no-coverage-warning replaces it. Update the test spec to expect this.

Not tested: no-coverage-pickup-btn and fulfillment-delivery-btn, because /api/stores returns no stores and the delivery/pickup toggle only renders when stores > 0. Seed a store with stock for a TEST_ product to cover this path.
critical_code_review_comments: MUNI-06 is enforced in redeem() with toasts, not by disabling confirm-redeem. This is allowed by the spec, but disabling the button when addr.trim().length < 6 or the phone has fewer than 8 digits would show the requirement earlier.

MunicipalDeliveryPicker's quote effect catch branch clears the quote but does not call onNoCoverage or onMunicipality. A network error after a valid quote leaves the parent's deliveryMunicipality as null, which is already set at effect start, so it is safe. It does mean no error message is shown to the user.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable checks (pickup button path not testable: no stores)

seed_data_creation: Re-ran /app/backend/tests/seed_iter373_ui.py because TEST_ui373_cheap and TEST_ui373_big had is_active=False and did not show in the marketplace. Some other test's cleanup probably deactivated them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth: add cookie session_token (muni_smoke_admin, muni_emp_deliv or muni_smoke_vip), secure, sameSite None, on the preview domain. The province select is hidden when there is only one province (La Habana is auto-selected). Municipality options read like 'Vedado — 3 USDT', so match with a regex '^Vedado'. There is no 'Playa' municipality; use Arroyo Naranjo (5 USDT) to see the fee change. If the TEST_UI373 products disappear, run tests/seed_iter373_ui.py.
